review_notes: I read the whole file and checked its simp interface. The file declares no @[simp] lemmas. It calls `simp` only inside private proofs, and those calls are targeted: `simp [determinantOneIdeal, determinant_one]`, `simp [Matrix.mvPolynomialX]`, and `simp only [...]` with explicit lemma lists. The one candidate was the private `determinant_map`. A grep of the algebraic-groups sources shows it is used once, by name, inside a `simp only` call. Making it a global simp lemma would not help any actual use, and its LHS `MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap K F) (determinant K n)` could compete with other determinant or map lemmas. I found no competing rules, unwanted expansion, rewrite cycle or missing canonical simp lemma. I did not run Lean, so I have not checked simp behaviour experimentally.
